The '''Little Gold Ring''' was a weak ''[[angreal]]'' aligned to ''[[saidar]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Graendal}} It was a very little plain ring of gold that entered only in the small finger of [[Graendal]].{{ref/book|8|11}} she found it searching in [[Sammael]]'s quarters in [[Illian]] while the [[Forsaken]] was fighting against [[Rand]] in [[Shadar Logoth]], or just a little time after. Previously the ring was probably stolen from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]] by a group of [[Darkfriend]]s and given to Sammael.

Graendal used it against [[Moghedien]] and [[Cyndane]] when they come to give her orders from the [[Nae'blis]]. She probably used it also in the [[Battle near Shadar Logoth]] against the circle led by [[Verin]].

The ring was destroyed by Rand's [[balefire]] assault on Graendal's fortress of [[Natrin's Barrow]].
